definitions.primary: For each resource, retain complete meaningful semantic phases with zero issues on that resource; remove preceding resource tails, merge exact-adjacent eligible phases, and permit fully idle control-only bridges only between work phases. Any resource-issuing phase is excluded entirely, including idle holes. No duration threshold is applied.
definitions.resource_dq: External data bursts including ordinary read/write CL/CWL delays.
definitions.resource_global_ca: Shared channel/global command resource only; rank-private command resources are separate and not added to global CA.
definitions.resource_dq_global_ca: Both external DQ and shared global CA must be idle. The union of their busy reservations and all their issue times qualify primary phases.
definitions.physical: Maximal idle gaps of the resource inside its scope, including possibly tiny transfer-phase gaps; diagnostics only.
definitions.diagnostic_joint: DQ-complete work envelopes intersected with shared-global-CA idle. CA pulses split these windows, which may be fragmentary and are not the strict complete-work primary metric.
definitions.sums: complete_work_idle_sum_us is a sum of separate complete windows; only longest_complete_work_window_us is one continuous interval. idle_total_us and diagnostic_joint_sum_us are also sums, never continuous time.
definitions.clocks: Half-open integer frontend ticks; first memory edge=(CK-1)*frontend_ratio+1. Scope boundaries clip windows. Independent native runs are never concatenated.
definitions.simultaneous: channel=all_channels uses the union of all 16 channels' occupied resources and retains every original issue for phase qualification.
definitions.missing: Unavailable CA is null, not zero. Legacy flat CA is reconstructed only with a source- and raw-hash-verified explicit contract.
definitions.limitations: Resource idle is not measured GPU service time or an electrical waveform. Strict complete-work results depend on semantic phase granularity; zero means no complete phase qualifies, not that the bus is always occupied.
